MORE:
We would like to inform that the Board of Directors at the meeting held today i.e. Friday, November 06, 2026 inter alia considered and approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

The Board Meeting commenced at 04:00 pm. and concluded at 04:45 p.m.

In reference to the above intimation and pursuant to the applicable provisions of SEBI Listing Regulations, we attach herewith Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 along with the Limited Review Report thereon.
